LanguageData.PawnDiary.Settings.EnableExternalKeyShar: Share API keys with other mods

When enabled, other mods that use the integration API can read your configured LLM API keys in full, so a companion mod can reuse your provider. Leave this off unless you trust the other mods in your load order: any loaded mod can request them. When off, mods can still see that a key is set, but not its value.
LanguageData.PawnDiary.Settings.EnableErrorReportingT: When enabled, errors raised by this mod are sent to the author to help find and fix bugs. Before sending, each report is scrubbed of personal data: usernames in file paths, API keys, and your colony and colonist names are removed, and the text is length-capped. A report contains the scrubbed error text and stack, this mod's version, your RimWorld version, active DLC, your operating system, and an anonymous random install id — never your API keys or diary text. Because the error text comes from exceptions, an unusual message could still contain an in-game value we did not anticipate. Turn this off to send nothing.
LanguageData.PawnDiary.ErrorReporting.NoticeText: Pawn Diary sends anonymous, scrubbed reports of its own errors to the author by default, to help find and fix bugs. Reports never include your API keys or diary text, and usernames in file paths plus your colony and colonist names are removed before sending. You can change this any time in the mod settings.

LanguageData.PawnDiary.Settings.InjectGeneratedSpeech: Add generated speech to the Social log

When enabled, a completed initiator diary entry with a valid speech block adds one new Social-log line containing that generated spoken text. This can let mods that watch new interaction log entries react after the LLM result is ready.
